And he who robbed them,
Well?
It's Pluto!
It's Pluto!
Because always righteousness of my mind and my striving, I condemn you to give it back to him!
Oh, woe, he gives it to me!
Oh, woe, he'll take it from me!
So I can see if you're going to be obedient,
I want to go to the underworld today.
O take us all with you, we ask you very nicely!
Oh, Dad, take me with you, too.
Well, I want my whole farm to go with me today!
O let us consecrate thanks to him,
To him whose heart is so mild and soft!
He's going with us, and not alone,
In that dark realm of shadows.
Pleasure will be the final punishment,
You'll be a little scattered.
Thank you, Jupiter, for this happiness!
I'm indignant to the highest!
Good law has triumphed.
Farewell forever, my good luck!
I'm so touched!
Good law has triumphed.
Thank you, Jupiter, for this happiness!
Take your attributes with you,
And go on in solemn step!

Heaven, what a hell-pee! - I have been bored on earth often enough, especially when Orpheus, my husband, joined me, or when he presented me with a piece of future music. But this stay is still much, much more boring. I have already counted all the discs and recited the small and the big once-in-a-time five times. Otherwise! Time grows over my head, and I do not manage to beat them dead. And yet I am much better alone than in company with that sentimental single-folding brush, which is made my prison keeper; for this man is even more boring than the boredom. O Pluto! Pluto!
If I didn't miss the cure, I might have the courage to tell her how lovely she is.
What do you want?
Madam!
Well?
Didn't the lady ring the bell?
No! No!
Woe to me!
Why those sighs?

If the lady had ringed, it would have proved to me that the lady wished for something. But since the lady did not ring, this is a clear proof that the lady had no need. At the Olympic, she is beautiful, glorious, worthy of worship! Will the lady ring soon?
I know, why do you ask?
If the lady rang, I'd be in a hurry.
I don't care.
The warm participation that the gracious woman seems to feel for me encourages me to make my inner air. It must come out! My heart is willing, but my head is weak.
What's it to me?
The woman who loved me would be very happy --
In the end, he'll tell me his love stories.
I have only one mistake and I would rather confess it immediately, so that the lady can not blame me later. - I always drink when I am thirsty and - I am always thirsty.
He's not crazy, he's drunk.
Now that I unfold my inner man in front of the gracious woman -
Don't come any closer, unfortunate!

After such a sincere confession, the gracious woman exults me with enthusiasm! And why? - Because I am a servant! -- women! women! - But I was not told at the cradle that I would live such a life once after my death. Why should I hide it even longer? When I was still walking on earth, I was Prince of Arcadia.
Arcadia, it's also a beautiful area.
When I was Prince of Arcadia,
I live in wealth, splendor and splendor.
Everything went straight to the executioner,
When death killed me.
But this would be easy to hurt;
There's only one thing that gets too close to me.
That I was in those stages of life,
That I never saw you, Holde,
When I was Prince of Arcadia.
If I were the prince of Arcadia,
You shared my power with me;
But unfortunately, I am only a shadow,
Because death killed me.
A poor shadow can donate nothing,
As what was left to him;
So you want to grace him up
And take it stuffed with hot love -
The heart of the Prince of Arcadia.
You're going to Bacchus.
Madam, I guess what you're saying, but you're wrong! You misunderstood the words I dropped earlier in my thirst. I never drink wine, but water, nothing but water.
How?
I'm constantly drinking Lethe to forget my present most unfortunate situation.
What a droll idea!

Madam, this is the best water cure. I remember that I once drove four-spanned - so I'll take a sip of Lethe; remember that I once rested on soft cushions and moved a dozen servings through a wink - so I drink half a slob of Lethe; the memory of some previously experienced happiness pushes on me to a previously felt joy - so I drink Lethe, Lethe, Lethe. - Too bad that this delicious drink evaporates so quickly and that so often one has to pour it on in order to drive away the memory. - Of course I also sometimes forget an order from my master and then have to forget it.
Unspeakable!
If I wasn't for a domesticism in the shadow realm, I would-- oh, woe, that's my principle.
What does this noise mean?
Nothing, nothing, ma'am, you have to go in!
I don't want to!
It's my master's order that he would let me nail my ear to the door if he found you here.
But how long will this story last?
Later everything will clear up! Now - just in!
Oh Pluto! Pluto! Your pitfall should be dear to you!
Hurry, hurry, it was the time!
She's not here!

A strange way to make the Honneurs in your home! If you have a way of life, you let the people enter and follow them. You don't have to push the courtesy so far that you push and push yourself - where are we here?
In my small apartments, or as the Spaniards say, in my buen retiro.
I'm convinced she's hidden somewhere.
You're looking for something, I see. Have you lost something here, Brother Olympier?
I'm just looking at the wallpapers and the paintings.
It's a hell-breughel.
Beautiful! Very nice! At all I like it here - so secretly! I want to have such a cabin set up in Olympus. It's so cheap for -- isn't it?
I'm not one of the passionate gods who compromise their high dignity by profane love hands. I have other things to do in the underworld than celebrating shepherds.
Every inch of you is a tartuff! What are you doing? Intriguing behind my back?
What a gloomy suspicion! I just made--
You made someone sign.
Who?
That pole seal varnish!
Hans Styx, my factotum - a good, honest boy. I trust him -
Your secrets, where is she?
Who?
Eurydice, by my thunderbolt!
What, Eurydice, despite everything I told you, you still think I kidnapped that girl?
I believe it, and I'll figure it out.
Well?
Nothing! You're right! With my immortality, I, who have taken so many forms to please the women, - I will still invent a suitable one here. Under whatever form it is, - I have to get in there!
Now come on! Let's go back to the gods who are waiting for us at the feast. I have arranged a great purpose-eating to celebrate your arrival. You shall have a rehearsal of my Hell Kitchen.

Good, good! My brother in the underworld, I give you my respect again. I have a thought! - I will leave my card here for her to know that I am here and in a few moments I will return through the keyhole in the finest and most seductive figure! - That's all I say!
Don't let him out of his sight - he's smart and could come back secretly. I'm going behind him, you're behind me!

I thought I heard voices. - No one here! What does this card with the turned corner mean? Who sent it to me? "Zeus von Donnersmark"! Should anyone think of me? - My life for the one who frees me from my prison!
That's certainly fine! - In this costume you slip everywhere. - There it is! How beautiful it is! - Jupiter, show now your old practice!
I thought I felt something here,
It's like a little breeze blowing at me.
Now it's my role to play
As a cunning, delicate galan.
That's why I start humming.
Oh, the pretty fly!
And she hums so nicely!
That she likes you,
Toen', O little song, toen'!
O say, O golden-winged creatures,
Do you want to be my companion here?
I've been chosen as a victim.
And that's why they locked me in here.
Oh, stay, how will I keep you here,
A lot of sugar juice I prepare for you;
I want to love you, I want to care for you,
O stay here, o stay here!
Let not the love be fleeting,
Let's be asked first fine.
By the wings, I'll catch them!
Oh, that would be way too soon!
You mean beast! Let it succeed;
You won't always escape me.
I've got to win the last time.
And see you in my hands.
My beautiful child, I have wings,
And you could get away very easily.
Gradually you shall succeed,
To see me in your snares!
Just so I don't hurt her,
I'll make this veil a net,
Carefully, I'll take her!
Oh, don't be too early.
That's how it's done!
- You've gone online yourself!
I got her! I got her!

Oh, I knew I would catch you, my kind winged sweetheart! You may resist as you please - I will not let you go. You shall be the comfort of the poor prisoners. But look how cute she is! What beautiful colors! - And what a fine waist! - And these golden wings! - Hold! - I must hug you!
Now look, all this is your worshiped mortals, if you will!
Gods, she speaks!
O child! Do not scream! - I am not really a fly at all; I took the form merely to deceive the eyes of a simple tyrant who only wants to torment you.
Is it possible?
I'm your worshiper Zeus, the Kronide, the cloud collector, the Hochdinner, and so on.
So it was you who just got this map--
Put through the keyhole - yes, I, the King of the Gods - no more and no less.
Oh!

And if I had known you before, things would have been quite different. Pluto would not have dragged you down into the underworld; I would have lifted you up to Olympus. You would not have sunk, you would have gone up.
Come on, let's get out of here!
I have to go to the diner that Pluto has arranged in my honor. Come under some disguise, and at the end, when the enthused deities leave, I will lead you away with me in the crowd.
What a God promises, he will certainly keep! - Goodbye, Zeus! Yours for ever!
Oh, what a happy insect I am!
Fly! Fly! "Would I still be the prince of Arcadia!"
Where is she?
The fly, what fly?
Jupiter I mean, the little scum Cupido recognized under the shape of a fly!
Jupiter? "When I was Prince of Arcadia"...
What did you do to Eurydice?
"I live in wealth, splendor and splendor"...

Look at me, lad! Oh, the unfortunate one! He has already drunk Lethe water again! And during that time he let him in. Listen, Hans, my faithful Hans! It is I, Pluto, your good master! - Dog soul! - In the name of your ashes! In the name of your earthly remnants! Will you finally remember? Give me at least the key to the garden lattice! - The key!
"But everything went straight to the executioner"...
If I speak to him in another language than he forgot, perhaps his memory would come back to him. Souviens-toi! - Ricordati! - Acuerdate! - Memento! - Remember!
Remember! "When death killed me!"...
Nothing, nothing, it's about losing your mind!
O say, you gold-winged beings! etc.

Oh, that voice! - It's Eurydice! - So she's not gone yet! Now quickly! Hey, Cerberus! Charon! Double your vigilance! Close all the exits! And you come, Hans! -Hans! - The guy doesn't move from the spot.
"If I were the prince of Arcadia," etc.
That's not a human being, that's a two-legged lyre box!
Long live Pluto and his wine!
If you're not a scoundrel, join in!
The Godship From Above
Must praise this little wine;
Save the glasses!
Vivat the wack're host!
Only he knows how to live
And to give such a feast,
But his striving goes there,
That glass is ringing at glass!
Well, lovely bacchantin!
Which can compare itself with Venus;
Tune with your sweet throat
Now on the Hymn on Bacchus!
Sing, sing, beautiful bacchantin!
I saw God Bacchus once enthroned on the barrel of wine,
He gave to his faithful the most cheerful teaching;
The nymph and the faun, so the groves inhabit,
They sang around him:
Evohe, your holy fire is burning in me!
I want to serve you!
Evohe, your holy fire is burning in me!
I want to serve you!
The mortals, he said, let sorrow be tormented,
With gloomy grief, which robs them of all joy.
You may choose the vine foliage and the roses and braid around the head!
Evohe! Your holy fire, etc.
While my step is so easy, my foot so small and nice,
So now I'm dancing with you the newest minuet.
Pluto didn't know you; after the dance we get out of the dust.
Jupiter thinks I didn't recognize the bacchantin, but I won't let her out of my sight.
Father Jupiter so long to dance before us, -
It's too beautiful in sight!
What a delight! O see how light he floats,
How graceful he raises his foot!
This high grace
Delighted everyone,
So that even Terpsichore
Can envy him.
Galop now closes the ball,
Like the carnival
Almost always the case.
Hop! Hop!
Long live the gallop!
And now - let's escape!
Yes, let's flee! Let's use the little breath that left us in the dance.
Where to!
Oh, woe!
What's that toll-booze thing for?
Do you think I didn't recognize the woman in this bacchantin?
That you didn't take, like you said?
Well, I kidnapped her, but the hell I've regretted it a hundred times!
What's he saying?
I'm saying that you were dealing with me, like your husband, that in my hell you got everything under and over.
He knows everything!
Laugh! Those who laugh last laugh best! The story is over! You will not take them after the Olympus!
Who would stop me if I wanted to?
You yourself, and her husband.
Oh, my husband - I forgot!
Yes, that happens sometimes! And you - have also forgotten what you promised him! - O, I will be avenged! Not to me you will return Eurydice, but to him, the violinist of the future.
O I gate! Why did I make such a promise!
The situation is now being elevated, the simple prose is no longer doing it. We have to speak in verses!
O woman, do you recognize the far-off violin sound?
It's my husband!
He came down to us, and brought you to the earth,
It's a gift I'm going to give her!
O Jupiter!
Shut up! I have my plan!
The Sach' is, believe me, not so easily dismissed!
Take your seats now and take your stand!
The bark that wears it is already swollen there!
You have convinced me! Although she was very presumptuous;
She alone is my wife, I must forget the guilt!
Ruler of Olympus!
Spare yourself the word, I know the story!
What Zeus has promised you, Jupiter will hold you.
You take your wife back and then it stays the same.
Go on!
I must add myself to the saying of the gods - it is!
Patience, but I'll add the condition.
Which I thought up, only for your sake,
You don't need to know why.
You're going to the Styx with your wife,
She's behind you, but you can't look backwards.
Otherwise, for eternity, they would disappear from you.
That's not what I said!
Hey, who's murmuring here?
- Eurydice will go behind Orpheus!
But don't turn around!
Don't turn your eyes backwards.
Just keep looking forward!
You may think of the earth,
We're both expected there!
Now be careful what will happen!
Does he have the strength not to look around?
That's how I was wrong?
He should be without curiosity?
The victory is yours!
He hasn't turned around yet!
I've got the lightning right here by my hand.
Woe to you! You looked back!
I don't even know how to happen to me!
She's lost to you forever!
She's still staying with me!
Not you, not me!
Why?
No, I'll make her a bacchantin now.
But it's not in mythology!
Well, that's how our Court Book Printshop is supposed to make a different edition of it!
Bacchus, since I'm from Earth
Now be banished,
I want to be alone
Consecrate your service forever.
Gladly, I gladly flee the husband,
Do you want to, Bacchus, just allow me to...
To be your faithful priestess!
La, la, la, la!
